name: @deterministic-code/generators-sql
description: SQL generator pack for the deterministic toolchain: per-dialect DDL/migration/stored-procedure emit.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/templates dist/
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/common/sql-schema.test.ts src/common/default-casing.test.ts src/common/sql-keywords.test.ts src/generate-sql.test.ts src/generate-sql.casing.test.ts
